# Sample Research Document

This is a sample document for testing the Research Worker.

## Section 1: Jyotish Fundamentals

Jyotish is the ancient Indian system of astrology. It uses the sidereal zodiac
and provides insights into planetary positions and their influences.

The natal chart is computed from the birth data and contains planetary positions
in the sidereal zodiac.

## Section 2: Divisional Charts

Divisional charts (vargas) are computed from the natal chart positions.
The navamsa (D9) is particularly important for marriage analysis.

Varga charts provide additional layers of information about specific life areas.

## Section 3: Transits

Transits (gochar) track planetary movements relative to the natal chart.
Jyotish transit analysis uses the sidereal zodiac positions.

Planetary transits influence daily events and long-term trends.
